purpose: Infer the drafting logic of the handwritten Telaio 5 load sheet without silently correcting the source.

rules.name: TRAVERSO_DEFAULT
rules.description: A heading TRAVERSO followed by a load build-up establishes a default line-load recipe for the node group unless later TRATTO entries override parts of it.

rules.name: TRATTO_OVERRIDE
rules.description: A TRATTO entry naming a node sequence applies to the consecutive segments spanned by those nodes and overrides the broader TRAVERSO default for those segments.

rules.name: NODE_SEQUENCE_TO_SEGMENTS
rules.description: n listed nodes define n-1 consecutive beam segments. Example 37-38-39-40 = segments 37-38, 38-39, 39-40.

rules.name: RESIDUAL_ASSIGNMENT
rules.description: If specific TRATTO overrides cover all but one or more segments, an earlier TRAVERSO default may apply to the uncovered residual segments, provided no later correction supersedes that default.

rules.name: MANUAL_CORRECTION_CHAIN
rules.description: When the author writes a second build-up immediately after a first, accompanied by a corrective note, the second build-up is a candidate revision of the first rather than an additional independent load case.

rules.name: DO_NOT_SILENTLY_FIX
rules.description: Arithmetic, labeling, omission, and drafting errors remain visible as source facts. A corrected engineering reading must be stored as an interpretation with rationale, never as a replacement of the historical text.
